lyrics:
[Intro: robotic low chant, pulsing synth bass, four-on-the-floor kick]
Cam, cam, cam, ah
Cam, cam, cam, ah

[Verse 1: low, half spoken, cool]
I can run a meeting with a storm inside my chest
Nod along and take the notes and tell them I'm impressed
Little green light watching and I'm framed from here to here
What you can't see can't hurt me, dear

[Pre-Chorus: synths rise, voice lifts]
Oh, oh-oh-oh
I'll smile until the hour's up
Oh, oh-oh-oh
And then I'll come undone

[Chorus: big, stacked vocals, stuttered hook]
You'll never see, never see
What I'm doing with my c-c-camera off
(Muted, I'm muted)
C-c-camera off, c-c-camera off
(Muted, I'm muted)
C-c-camera off, c-c-camera off

[Verse 2: low, half spoken, a little wicked]
You ask me how I'm feeling and I tell you that I'm fine
I've got a perfect background and a ring light and a line
But if you saw the kitchen, if you saw the state of me
I'm crying or I'm dancing or it's secret number three

[Pre-Chorus: synths rise, voice lifts]
Oh, oh-oh-oh
I'll smile until the hour's up
Oh, oh-oh-oh
And then I'll come undone

[Chorus: big, stacked vocals, stuttered hook]
You'll never see, never see
What I'm doing with my c-c-camera off
(Muted, I'm muted)
C-c-camera off, c-c-camera off
(Muted, I'm muted)
C-c-camera off, c-c-camera off

[Bridge: beat drops to kick and bass, spoken deadpan]
Is she crying?
Is she dancing?
Is she even wearing shoes?
You'll never know
You'll never know

[Chant: robotic voices, building, claps]
Cam, cam, cam, ah
Cam, cam, cam, ah
Cam, cam, cam, ah

[Final Chorus: everything, ad-libs, extra synth lead]
You'll never see, never see
What I'm doing with my c-c-camera off
(Muted, I'm muted)
C-c-camera off, c-c-camera off
(Muted, I'm muted)
C-c-camera off, c-c-camera off

[Outro: chant alone, a call-ending tone]
Cam, cam, cam, ah
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 119 BPM, 4/4, G-sharp minor. A stomping, mechanical dance pulse. Cool, sly and theatrical.

VOICE: Female lead with a low, dark, slightly androgynous tone in the verses, delivered half spoken with a raised eyebrow. A bigger, brighter, belted sound in the chorus, layered many times. A pitched-down robotic male-sounding voice performs the chant. The bridge is spoken flat and deadpan.

INSTRUMENTS: A thick, buzzing synth bass playing a pulsing pattern. A hard four-on-the-floor kick with a sharp clap. Staccato synth stabs. A bright, slightly detuned lead synth in the chorus. Filtered noise sweeps. Almost no acoustic sounds at all.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, the robotic chant over kick and bass. 0:16 Verse 1. 0:32 Pre-chorus. 0:48 Chorus 1 with the stutter. 1:12 Verse 2. 1:28 Pre-chorus. 1:44 Chorus 2. 2:08 Bridge, kick and bass, spoken. 2:24 Chant, building with claps. 2:36 Final chorus with ad-libs and an extra synth line. 3:08 Outro, the chant alone, ending on a video-call hang-up tone at 3:30.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Late-2000s electro-pop: hard, glossy and compressed, bass and kick dominant, vocals processed and wide.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The first stutter on the title in the chorus at 0:52.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The mask is a video call. The song's joke and its sadness are both familiar to anyone who has kept a camera off, and the secret is left for each listener to name.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Control, mischief, a glimpse of strain, control again.
